blocks.headline: How Mellon uses AI in its work.
blocks.subhead: Where we use AI tools, where we don't, and who is accountable for what you receive.

sections.heading: Our position.
sections.body: We use AI tools to speed up parts of the work. Design decisions, conversations with you, and the final call on every deliverable stay with the people on your project.

sections.heading: The quick chat on this site.
sections.body: The chat button is an AI assistant that helps you say what you need and fills in the contact form for you to check. It answers from the services and prices published on this site, and nothing else. What you type goes to our AI provider, DeepSeek, so it can write replies, and we don't save the conversation. Nothing reaches us until you press send on the form. Details are in our privacy policy.

sections.heading: If your company has an AI policy.
sections.body: Tell us at the start of the project. You can write to us at {email}.

sections.heading: More detail, soon.
sections.body: We're still documenting the specifics behind this page — exactly where AI is and isn't used, how client files are handled, and who reviews and owns the result. Thank you for reading closely enough to notice. We'd rather publish that properly than fill the gap with placeholder copy, so it's coming as soon as it's ready.
